steps.name: 1. A, B, C log in through the UI in separate browser contexts
2. A and B create posts in the UI (exact place required) and see each other in the list
3. list and detail show 시·구·동 only, never the exact place (B and anon)
4. B sees A as masked real name + full age; anon is asked to log in
5. B requests A post once; a repeated request is blocked
6. A and B exchange messages in both directions without reloading
7. A confirms B as the final companion (UI shows the stored exact place to the author)
8. only B newly sees the exact place; C still cannot
9. completion before the end time is refused by the server
10. after the end time A confirms completion and immediately submits a review
11. B only learns that A submitted — no rating or comment
12. B confirms completion → appointment completed on both screens
13–14. B reviews blind; then both see each other’s review
15. state survives reload, logout and re-login
16. C and anon cannot read the request, chat, appointment, exact place, completion or reviews
17. A and B cannot read each other’s raw real name, birth date or phone
no uncaught page errors in A/B/C/anon browsers
